articles.title: India-China Talks Yield 8-Point Consensus; New Military Hotlines, Border Talks On The Table
articles.description: India and China have reached an eight-point consensus after the 25th round of Special Representatives’ talks in Beijing between NSA Ajit Doval and Wang Yi. Both sides reaffirmed their commitment to peace along the border and agreed to advance boundary negotiations. Two additional military meeting points and two new hotline channels were agreed for the Eastern and Middle Sectors. India also welcomed more Kailash Mansarovar Yatra batches and the reopening of three border trading points.

articles.title: Mohan Bhagwat in New York: Mamdani Opposes RSS Event, Mary Millben Hits Back | Raw Report
articles.description: A political controversy is brewing in New York over RSS chief Mohan Bhagwat’s August 29 event at Madison Square Garden.New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani has said he does not support the planned gathering, describing the RSS vision as “exclusionary” and contrasting it with the pluralistic and secular India he says he grew up knowing. However, Mamdani also acknowledged that City Hall may not have jurisdiction to cancel a privately organised event.The event, billed as the “Universal Oneness Celebration,” is being organised by American Hindus for Engagement and Dialogue and is expected to bring together thousands of members of the Hindu-American community. Organisers say the programme focuses on shared heritage, interfaith dialogue and unity. The RSS has responded to the controversy by stressing its commitment to open dialogue and inclusivity.American singer Mary Millben has also criticised Mamdani’s opposition and defended the event, saying critics should organise their own gathering if they disagree with it n18oc_indian18oc_raw-report News18 Mobile App - https://onelink.to/desc-youtube

articles.title: Skardu Base Was India’s Target During Operation Sindoor, Ex-CDS Reveals Why Strike Was Aborted
articles.description: Pakistan’s strategically important Skardu military base is back in focus after former CDS General Anil Chauhan revealed that India had planned to strike it during Operation Sindoor. Located around 170 kilometres from Kargil, Skardu has long been significant to Pakistan’s military strategy and was used to support troops during the Kargil War. Chauhan said the strike was aborted at the last moment due to bad weather. The base also provides security cover to the China-Pakistan Economic Corridor. Meanwhile, India struck several Pakistani bases, including Bholari, Sargodha and Nur Khan, using BrahMos, SCALP and Rampage missiles.
